metadata.description: FORSVN turns your coding agent into a full product team — composable skills across research, marketing, product, and process. One front door (/forsvn) routes any request; every skill writes artifacts the next one reads, so context compounds. Single install from github.com/hungv47/meta-skills.

plugins.name: forsvn
plugins.description: Composable skills across research, marketing, product, and meta (process), plus a bundled review surface. /forsvn is the single front door — describe what you want in plain English and it routes you. Skills emit plain Markdown; /forsvn:review renders a themed preview and captures your approve / deny / request-changes decision. Renamed from forsvn-skills; still distributed from hungv47/meta-skills for URL continuity.
